about_the_game:
AN UNKNOWN THREAT!

Unknown threat has unearthed from an abandoned planet and millions of bug-like creatures have begun an all out assault on the entire solar system. The situation seemed desperate until a mysterious drill shuttle began charging towards the planet. A new hope perhaps? Descent into the depths of the planet, rescue the trapped soldiers, destroy the source of the threat and don't get consumed by the noise!

EMBRACE THE CHAOS!

ULTRA CORE DIVE is a dark and chaotic arcade twinstick shooter inspired by the masters of the genre. The game features a dark retro inspired pseudo-1bit aesthetic with tons of action on screen. The gameplay is familiar fast-paced twinstick shooter action with a small learning curve, complimented with a tough-as-nails difficulty.

Shoot and dodge your way through 5 Zones, featuring 50 handcrafted Arenas filled with waves-and-waves of enemies and hazards! Fight huge and brutal BOSSES that fill the screen with bullets!

Power up and equip powerful weapons and abilities with a semi-randomized upgrade system! Be the arcade master and rack up score multipliers and bonuses!

Don't get consumed by the noise!

FLASHING WARNING!

The game features frequently flashing on screen effects that photosensitive and/or epileptic may find discomforting!

Viewer discretion is adviced!
